content.comment_body: Hello, Is it possible to receive a copy of the firmware for [product_name] [article_no]? When powered on, the display shows that the firmware has crashed. Is it possible to repair this at [company_name]? Thank you, [user_name].
Hi [user_name], welcome to the forum. My recommendation is to initiate a support request.

Hello, The only option I am aware of is attempting the firmware update from [product_name] [version_no] FS:04 or FS:05 to FS:06. You can find detailed information and the update file at [url]. During the update, ensure the power remains within the specified limits and avoid any electromagnetic interference. Hope this is helpful.
